_comment: Named lever sets for the MapGen UI and --preset. A preset lists only the levers it moves; everything else stays at the generator default (src/biome/knobs.js, BIOME_DEFAULTS). 'nostalgia' IS the default: the corpus-calibrated values of queue items 18-24, measured against K's own RandomMaps archive, which is Nostalgia-family, Jebus Cross and Headquarters maps for the most part.

nostalgia.label: Nostalgia
nostalgia.help: The default. Calibrated against the random maps you have played: zone rims, treasure, mines, towns, monsters and terrain at the rates those maps carry.
